Dobson Ranch golf rounds and realized revenue

Source: R/data.R
dobson_rounds.Rd

Activity and revenue for Dobson Ranch Golf Course, published by the City of Mesa Parks, Recreation and Community Facilities. The city describes the course as operated by Paradigm Golf Group. This object is the open-data extract saved on 2026-10-03, dataset 24g5-hb8k, after prepare_dobson_rounds() parses dates, currency, and the city's percent field. Blank source cells stay missing. No row is imputed, and the absent day 2024-12-10 is not added.

Usage

dobson_rounds

Format

A golfops_rounds data frame with 1838 rows and 38 variables:

row_id

City field RowID. The catalog calls it a unique identifier. The CSV prints thousands separators; those are removed and the value is stored as a number.

date

City field Date, parsed to a date. The catalog says this is when the golf round was played. Monthly total rows are dated the first of the month.

calendar_year

Calendar year of date. It equals the source Calendar Year on every row. The catalog description is "Calendar year".

fiscal_year

City fiscal-year label, such as FY15-16. The catalog says the City of Mesa fiscal year is July 1 through June 30 and that the field uses the two-year designation. The label matches the source Fiscal Year on every row.

month

Month of date, as a factor with levels January through December. It matches the source Month on every row.

day

Day of the month from date. It matches the source Day on every row.

weekday

Weekday of date, as a factor with levels Monday through Sunday. It matches the source Day of Week on every row.

season

Source Season value, as a factor with levels Winter, Spring, Summer, and Fall. On every row it matches December–February as Winter, March–May as Spring, June–August as Summer, and September–November as Fall. The catalog description for Season is blank.

sunrise

City field Sunrise, kept as the published clock string HH:MM:SS. The catalog says "Time of sunrise" and does not give a time zone. Missing on 67 rows, the same rows where sunset and daylight_hours are missing.

sunset

City field Sunset, kept as the published clock string HH:MM:SS. The catalog says "Time of sunset" and does not give a time zone. Missing on the same 67 rows as sunrise.

daylight_hours

Sunset minus sunrise, in decimal hours, reading each clock string as a time on a 24-hour clock. Computed by prepare_dobson_rounds(). Missing on the same 67 rows as the clock strings. This column is not in the city catalog.

grain

day or month. month means rounds_played is at least 1000. This file has 1766 day rows and 72 month rows. The cutoff is not a catalog field.

rounds_played

City field Rounds Played. The catalog says "Number of rounds played". These are played rounds, not reserved tee times.

rounds_possible

City field Rounds Possible. The catalog says this is the number of rounds that could be played, found from the hours of daylight available. It is the city's daylight estimate, not a count of tee times on a tee sheet. Missing on 67 rows.

booking_rate

City field Round Booking Rate, divided by 100. The catalog defines it as the percent of possible rounds that were played, so the stored number is a proportion. On the 1771 rows where this value and rounds_played / rounds_possible are both defined, the largest absolute difference is 0.0005. The rate is above 1 on 109 rows. It is the city's played-over-possible percent, not a count or share of reserved tee times. Missing on 67 rows.

utilization

rounds_played / rounds_possible where rounds_possible is positive, from prepare_dobson_rounds(). It is the share of the daylight estimate that was played. Missing on 67 rows. This column is not in the city catalog.

open_daylight_rounds

max(rounds_possible - rounds_played, 0) where rounds_possible is present. Days with more played rounds than the daylight estimate are stored as 0. This is the unused portion of the daylight estimate, not a count of open tee times. Missing on 67 rows. This column is not in the city catalog.

cart_rentals

City field Cart Rentals. The catalog says "Number of carts used in golf rounds. Derived from Cart Revenue." Missing values stay missing.

cart_revenue

City field Cart Revenue. The catalog says "Revenue earned from cart rentals." The CSV prints a dollar sign; the column stores the parsed number. This is realized cart revenue, not a posted cart price. A missing value is a blank source cell.

club_rentals

City field Club Rentals. The catalog says "Number of club rentals. Derived from club rental revenue."

club_revenue

City field Club Revenue. The catalog says "Revenue earned from golf club rentals." Parsed from the dollar-formatted CSV value. Realized club-rental revenue, not a posted rental price.

food_beverage_revenue

City field Food and Beverage. The catalog says "Revenue earned from food and beverage sales." Parsed from the dollar-formatted CSV value.

green_fee_revenue

City field Green Fees. The catalog says "Revenue earned from green fees." Parsed from the dollar-formatted CSV value. This is realized green-fee revenue, not a published green fee and not a price for an available tee time.

merchandise_revenue

City field Merchandise Revenue. The catalog says "Revenue earned from merchandise revenue sales." Parsed from the dollar-formatted CSV value.

range_revenue

City field Range Sales. The catalog says "Revenue earned from driving range use." Parsed from the dollar-formatted CSV value.

ancillary_revenue

total_revenue - green_fee_revenue when both source amounts are present. Computed by prepare_dobson_rounds(). Missing on the 48 rows where total revenue is missing. This column is not in the city catalog.

total_revenue

City field Total Revenue. The catalog says it is the sum of cart revenue, club revenue, merchandise revenue, green fees, range sales, and food and beverage. Parsed from the dollar-formatted CSV value. Missing on 48 rows.

component_revenue

Sum of cart, club, food and beverage, green fee, merchandise, and range revenue on rows where all six amounts are present. Computed by prepare_dobson_rounds(). Missing on 164 rows, including rows where one or more category amounts are blank. This column is not in the city catalog.

revenue_per_round_source

City field Revenue/Round. The catalog says "Calculation: Total Revenue/Rounds." On the 1734 rows where this value and total_revenue / rounds_played are both defined, the largest absolute difference is 0.01. It is facility revenue per played round. It is missing for all 56 zero-round rows and for the 48 rows with no total revenue. It is not a published price.

green_fee_per_played_round

green_fee_revenue / rounds_played where rounds_played is positive. Computed by prepare_dobson_rounds(). Realized green-fee revenue per played round. Missing on 104 rows. This column is not in the city catalog and is not a posted green fee.

total_revenue_per_played_round

total_revenue / rounds_played where rounds_played is positive. Computed by prepare_dobson_rounds(). Missing on 104 rows. This column is not in the city catalog.

green_fee_per_daylight_round

green_fee_revenue / rounds_possible where rounds_possible is positive. Computed by prepare_dobson_rounds(). Green-fee revenue per daylight-estimated round. Missing on 67 rows. This column is not in the city catalog and is not revenue per open tee time.

total_revenue_per_daylight_round

total_revenue / rounds_possible where rounds_possible is positive. Computed by prepare_dobson_rounds(). Facility revenue per daylight-estimated round. Missing on 67 rows. This column is not in the city catalog.

flag_duplicate_date

TRUE when date appears on more than one row. Two rows are TRUE, both 2022-04-24, and they match on every other column.

flag_zero_rounds

TRUE when rounds_played is 0. Fifty-six rows are TRUE. The extract does not give a reason.

flag_above_daylight_capacity

TRUE when rounds_played is greater than rounds_possible. One hundred nine rows are TRUE: played rounds exceeded the city's daylight estimate.

flag_calendar_mismatch

TRUE when the source Month, Day of Week, Day, Season, or Fiscal Year disagrees with the value computed from date. Every row is FALSE in this extract.

flag_missing_total_revenue

TRUE when total_revenue is missing. Forty-eight rows are TRUE.

Source

City of Mesa. "Dobson Ranch Golf Rounds." Mesa Open Data, dataset 24g5-hb8k, Parks, Recreation and Community Facilities. Catalog page: https://data.mesaaz.gov/Parks-Recreation-and-Community-Facilities/Dobson-Ranch-Golf-Rounds/24g5-hb8k. Column descriptions are the catalog field descriptions. The catalog description of the dataset is: "Provides information on activity levels and revenues at Dobson Ranch Golf Course, which is operated by Paradigm Golf Group." The packaged file is the CSV saved 2026-10-03, Dobson_Ranch_Golf_Rounds_20261003.csv, copied without changes to inst/extdata/dobson_ranch_golf_rounds.csv. Both copies have SHA-256 d6b53a8dc37e80c9ec10ec3bc08cd834f3d6155cdeb9809ce0870cd7c1be0079. The catalog lists the data as public and links terms of use at https://data.mesaaz.gov/stories/s/2dcd-j2nx/.

Details

The extract records rounds the city says were played and revenue the city says was earned. It has no published price list, no inventory of available tee times, and no reservation records. rounds_played is play. green_fee_revenue and the other revenue columns are realized revenue. rounds_possible is the city's daylight estimate. booking_rate keeps the city's field name, Round Booking Rate, and stores the city's definition of that field: the percent of possible rounds that were played.

Every source row is kept. There are 1766 daily rows and 72 monthly totals. The monthly rows run from 2015-07-01 through 2021-06-01 and are dated the first of the month. In this file, daily rows have at most 675 rounds played and monthly rows have at least 2963, so grain labels a row month when rounds played are at least 1000 and day otherwise. That cutoff is the package rule stored in monthly_rounds_threshold. It is not a field in the city catalog. Add daily rows to daily rows, and monthly rows to monthly rows.

One daily row is dated 2004-12-10 and sits apart from the later series. From 2021-07-01 through 2026-04-30 the only missing date is 2024-12-10. The date 2022-04-24 occurs twice, and those two rows match on every column except row_id.

sunrise and sunset keep the source clock strings. The catalog does not give a time zone. Calendar labels are taken from date by prepare_dobson_rounds() and match the source Calendar Year, Fiscal Year, Month, Day, Day of Week, and Season values on every row.

Attributes source_path, source_url, and source_accessed record the bundled CSV, the catalog page, and the 2026-10-03 save date. A catalog metadata request on 2026-10-17 reported a later rows-updated time, 2026-10-17 02:17:12 UTC. This object was not replaced with that later update.

data(dobson_rounds)
str(dobson_rounds)
